text.en:
Registration of Births and Deaths Act
(CHAPTER 267)
Appointment of Deputy Registrars
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, the Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the following officers to be Deputy Registrars of Births and Deaths for the purposes of the Act, with effect from 30th June 1999:
(1)Commanding Officer, Woodlands Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(2)Commanding Officer, Choa Chu Kang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(3)Commanding Officer, Bukit Panjang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(4)Commanding Officer, Bukit Batok Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(5)Commanding Officer, Jurong West Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(6)Commanding Officer, Nanyang Neighbourhood Police Centre.
